prompt.en: The name Canada comes from the Iroquoian word kanata. What does that word mean?
prompt.fr: Le nom « Canada » vient du mot iroquoien « kanata ». Que signifie ce mot?

explanation.en: Two guides Cartier had taken prisoner used kanata, an Iroquoian word for a village. Map-makers were writing Canada on their charts by the 1550s.
explanation.fr: Deux guides que Cartier avait faits prisonniers ont employé « kanata », un mot iroquoien qui désigne un village. Dès les années 1550, les cartographes écrivaient « Canada » sur leurs cartes.

source.quote: Cartier heard two captured guides speak the Iroquoian word kanata, meaning “village.”

verification.evidence: Cartier heard two captured guides speak the Iroquoian word kanata, meaning “village.” By the 1550s, the name of Canada began appearing on maps.
